## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}

## Objective
- Build and finish a complete playable 2D pixel-art side-view samurai fighting game with parry, dodge, jump, and enemies that use the same abilities. The original issue request (Russian) was: «2д игра с видом с боку, игра пиксельная бои на самурайских мечах с системой паррирования, уклон, прыжки, врагам тоже самое».

## Requirements
- Complete, playable game; no clarifying questions.
- Must support desktop and mobile/touch controls.
- Game theme: pixel art, side view, samurai sword duels, parry system, dodge, jumping, enemies with equivalent mechanics.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained static HTML/CSS/JS game with no external assets/libraries.
- Five-wave structure ending in a boss (`LORD OF ASH`), with wave clears, healing, score, best score, victory/defeat screens.
- Combat design: light attacks parryable (white glint), red unblockable attacks must be dodged or jumped; perfect dodge, guard/posture break, enemy parry/dodge/jump AI.
- Added procedural WebAudio music/SFX, pixel-rendered characters/background, falling petals, HUD, pause, touch controls, gamepad support.
- Responsive portrait layout moves canvas to center of screen and touch controls below it; landscape keeps canvas full-frame with touch overlay.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js` from scratch.
- Implemented full game loop, title screen, wave system, boss phase 2, scoring, localStorage best score, pause, victory/defeat, restart.
- Implemented player and enemy combat states, parrying, blocking, posture break, dodging with i-frames, perfect dodge, jumping, red-attack jump immunity, AI attack patterns.
- Implemented procedural pixel background, characters, sword trails, particles, damage numbers, screen shake, hitstop, slow motion, wave banners, HUD.
- Added keyboard, touch, and gamepad input.
- Added portrait mobile layout with game centered and controls below.
- Verified with headless Chromium: no console/page errors; title, gameplay, combat, parry, perfect dodge, jump-vs-red, wave transitions, pause/resume, boss fight, victory, and defeat all work.
- Combo input buffering fixed via `attackQueue`; verified full 3-hit combo deals 41 damage.
- Adjusted HUD right-side coordinates to avoid overlap with sound button.
- Reduced touch-control sizes for short landscape screens.

### Active
- Final polish/testing and commit remain.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally re-run mobile/desktop screenshots after final CSS HUD changes to confirm no visual regressions.
2. Update `README.md` with game description/controls if desired.
3. Run `git status`, then commit all game files on branch `opencode/41889092060`.
4. Verify server output still serves correctly and report completion with a brief note of assumptions (five waves, boss, touch/gamepad support).

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: complete game logic, rendering, audio, input, entities, waves; ~3071 lines.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: DOM shell, overlays, controls legend, touch buttons.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: responsive layout, title/end/pause overlays, mobile portrait/landscape adjustments.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: default OMGithub README; not yet updated with game details.
- `/tmp/opencode/smoke.mjs`, `/tmp/opencode/mech.mjs`, `/tmp/opencode/defense.mjs`, `/tmp/opencode/progress.mjs`, `/tmp/opencode/mobile.mjs`: Playwright test scripts used to verify the game.
- `/tmp/opencode/server.log`, `/tmp/opencode/server.pid`: running static server on port 3002.

## Important Context
- Static server launched with: `RUNTIME_DIR=/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime PORT=3002 ./start.sh`; currently running via pid file `/tmp/opencode/server.pid`.
- Playwright must be imported as CommonJS default: `import pw from '/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/node_modules/playwright/index.js'; const { chromium } = pw;`.
- Tests confirmed: no page errors; parry increments `game.parries` and staggers attacker; red attacks cannot be parried; jumping avoids red attacks; perfect dodge increments `game.perfectDodges`; wave 1 clears to wave 2 with +22 HP; boss death triggers victory after ~3.4s; player death triggers gameover after ~1.8s.
- Debug API exists at `window.__blade` with `game`, `start()`, `wave(index)`, `win()`, `lose()`.
- The working tree currently has uncommitted changes: new `index.html`, `styles.css`, `game.js`; no git commit yet.
- One test oddity was caused by poor test setup, not a game bug: forcing boss HP to 1 without resetting enemy state left the boss attacking; a controlled retest confirmed boss victory works.

# Blade Wind — Moonlit Samurai Duel

A complete pixel-art, side-view samurai fighting game built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No external assets, libraries, or build step are required.

Fight through **five waves** of ronin, ninja, and the Iron Monk before facing the final boss, the **Lord of Ash**. Reading attacks and timing your defense matters more than mashing: white glints can be parried, while red-marked attacks must be dodged or jumped.

## Features

- **Parry system** — a well-timed parry staggers the attacker and builds posture damage; break an enemy's guard for a free punish.
- **Dodge and jump** — dodge with invincibility frames and perfect-dodge rewards; jump over sweeping red attacks.
- **Enemies play by the same rules** — opponents attack, block, parry, dodge, jump, and punish openings.
- **Five-wave campaign** — escalating duels, a two-phase boss, wave banners, healing between waves, score, best score, and victory/defeat screens.
- **Responsive controls** — keyboard on desktop, on-screen touch buttons on phones and tablets, and gamepad support.
- **Pixel presentation** — procedurally drawn characters and scenery, sword trails, particles, screen shake, hit-stop, and procedural WebAudio music and sound effects.

## Controls

| Action | Keyboard | Touch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Move | `A` / `D` or `←` / `→` | ◀ / ▶ |
| Jump | `Space` or `W` | ↑ |
| Attack | `J` | STRIKE |
| Parry | `K` | PARRY |
| Dodge | `L` | DODGE |
| Pause | `P` or `Esc` | Pause button |
| Mute | `M` | ♪ button |

Gamepads are supported through the standard Gamepad API: left stick / D-pad to move, face buttons to jump, attack, parry, and dodge, and Start to pause.

## Run it

Open `index.html` directly, or serve the folder over HTTP:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 3002
```

Then visit `http://localhost:3002`.

## Project files

- `index.html` — page shell, overlays, and touch controls.
- `styles.css` — responsive layout and menu styling.
- `game.js` — game loop, fighter state machines, enemy AI, rendering, audio, input, and wave flow.

## Tips

- A **white glint** means the attack can be parried. A **red mark** means it cannot — dodge or jump instead.
- Parrying at the last moment is stronger and counts as a perfect parry.
- Watch enemy posture: when it fills, their guard breaks and they are open to a heavy combo.
- Preserve health between waves; a small heal is granted after each clear.

 ## Features
 
 - **Parry system** — a well-timed parry staggers the attacker and builds posture damage; break an enemy's guard for a free punish.
+- **Three-hit blade combo** — `J` chains a wide side cut into a straight pierce, then a slow-charging **moonfall** finisher with a golden charge ring and heavy damage. The finisher takes a long time to wind up, so commit carefully.
 - **Dodge and jump** — dodge with invincibility frames and perfect-dodge rewards; jump over sweeping red attacks.
-- **Enemies play by the same rules** — opponents attack, block, parry, dodge, jump, and punish openings.
+- **Enemies play by the same rules** — opponents mix wide side cuts, straight thrusts, and charged overheads, and they also block, parry, dodge, jump, and punish openings.
 - **Five-wave campaign** — escalating duels, a two-phase boss, wave banners, healing between waves, score, best score, and victory/defeat screens.
 - **Responsive controls** — keyboard on desktop, on-screen touch buttons on phones and tablets, and gamepad support.
 - **Pixel presentation** — procedurally drawn characters and scenery, sword trails, particles, screen shake, hit-stop, and procedural WebAudio music and sound effects.

- **Red mark** — an unblockable overhead or lunge; dodge or jump it.

Готово. Добавил новые типы атак и заряженное комбо.

## Что нового

### Боковые и прямые атаки
- **Боковой разрез** — широкий горизонтальный удар с большим дуговым следом. Может задеть цель чуть позади.
- **Прямой выпад** — быстрый колющий удар с большей дальностью, но низким хитбоксом: его можно перепрыгнуть.
- У врагов теперь смешанные паттерны:
  - ронин — боковые разрезы, выпады и заряженные тяжёлые удары;
  - ниндзя — быстрые боковые атаки и стремительные выпады;
  - Железный монах — широкий боковой удар, мощный выпад и заряженный слэм;
  - босс — боковые серии, прямые выпады, рывки и красные заряженные атаки.

### Комбо игрока из трёх ударов
Нажатие `J` три раза запускает цепочку:

1. **SIDE CUT** — боковой разрез, 9 урона.
2. **PIERCE** — прямой выпад, 12 урона.
3. **CHARGED MOONFALL** — заряженный финальный удар: **0.62 сек. замаха**, 32 урона, сильный отброс и большой урон по стойке.

Во время зарядки третьего удара вокруг персонажа появляются золотое кольцо, свечение и частицы, а также проигрывается звук нарастающей энергии.

## Подсказки по телеграфам врагов
- **Белый ромб** — боковая атака, можно парировать.
- **Янтарная линия** — прямой выпад, можно парировать или перепрыгнуть.
- **Красная метка** — неблокируемая атака, только уклонение или прыжок.

## Проверка
Проверил в браузере:
- комбо реально проходит все три стадии и наносит урон `9 → 12 → 32`;
- третий удар имеет длинный замах и заряженные эффекты;
- у всех типов врагов есть и боковые, и прямые атаки;
- парирование, perfect dodge, прыжок через красные атаки, волны, босс, победа и поражение работают;
- touch-управление на мобильном работает;
- ошибок в консоли нет.

## Objective
- Transform the existing playable 2D samurai fighting game from a pixel-art presentation into a smooth, animated 2D game while keeping all combat mechanics intact.

## Requirements
- Remove the pixel-art visual design.
- Add animations; keep the game 2D side-view.
- Preserve existing gameplay: parry, dodge, jump, enemies with equivalent abilities, five waves, boss, touch/gamepad support.
- Previous requests remain satisfied: side and thrust attacks for player/enemies, plus a three-hit player combo ending in a slow-charged heavy finisher.

## Decisions
- Keep all existing game logic, combat state machines, AI, waves, scoring, and input.
- Raise canvas backing resolution to 1280×720 while retaining 640×360 logical coordinates via `RENDER_SCALE = 2`, and enable antialiasing.
- Replace blocky rendering with smooth vector/canvas drawing: gradients, rounded shapes, articulated limbs, cloth/hair motion, soft particles, and more expressive idle/run/attack/death animation.
- Replace pixel-style UI/fonts with elegant serif/sans typography, rounded glass panels, soft shadows, and remove scanlines/pixelated scaling.
- Keep cinematic moonlit samurai palette and UI layout, but render it in a smooth painted/animated style.

## Work State
### Completed
- Original complete game implemented and verified: five waves, boss, parry/dodge/jump, scoring, pause, victory/defeat, keyboard/touch/gamepad, procedural audio.
- Side and thrust attacks added for player and enemies; enemy patterns mix side cuts, thrusts, and charged overheads.
- Player `J-J-J` combo: side cut (9 dmg) → pierce (12 dmg) → charged moonfall (32 dmg, 0.62s windup) with golden charge VFX and charge sound.
- Previous commits:
  - `062af8d Add Blade Wind pixel samurai fighting game`
  - `e6f64a2 Add side and thrust attacks plus charged three-hit combo`
- Started visual overhaul:
  - `index.html`: canvas now `1280×720`, description updated, scanlines overlay removed.
  - `game.js`: top comment now says hand-animated 2D; added `RENDER_SCALE = 2`; enabled canvas antialiasing.
  - `styles.css`: switched to sans/serif fonts, removed body scanline texture, removed pixelated image rendering and `.scanlines` CSS, added rounded frame, restyled logo/buttons with soft shadows and blur.

### Active
- Finish the 2D animated visual overhaul:
  - Apply `ctx.setTransform(RENDER_SCALE, 0, 0, RENDER_SCALE, 0, 0)` at the start of `render()`.
  - Replace `drawText` monospace font with smooth UI/display fonts.
  - Rewrite fighter drawing with smooth articulated bodies, animated limbs, cloth, hair, faces, and swords.
  - Smooth background, effects, HUD, banner, and particles.
  - Finish remaining CSS (`control-card`, `kbd`, dialogs, stats, touch buttons, rotate hint) for the non-pixel style.
- Re-run browser screenshots/tests and verify all gameplay still works.
- Update `README.md` to reflect the new animated 2D art direction.
- Commit the visual overhaul (working tree currently has uncommitted changes).

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add render-scale transform in `render()` and update `drawText` font helpers.
2. Replace fighter rendering functions (`localLimb`, `swordPose`, `drawSwordLocal`, `drawScarf`, `drawCape`, `drawFighterHead`, `drawFighter`) with smooth animated 2D versions.
3. Modernize background, petals, effects, status bars, HUD, and banners.
4. Finish CSS polish for cards, keys, dialogs, stats, touch controls, and rotate hint.
5. Verify with Playwright: no console errors; title/game/mobile/landscape screenshots; combo, parry, dodge, jump-vs-red, waves, boss, victory/defeat.
6. Update README, commit all changes.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: all game logic/rendering; main visual-overhaul target.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: page, overlays, buttons, touch controls; partially converted to smooth style.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: canvas now 1280×720; scanlines removed.
